title: demo.pan_verify@v1 response (EXAMPLE ONLY, not a frozen contract)
description: The PAN's status at the Income Tax Department. An invalid PAN is a business answer (`pan_status: invalid`), not an error. Callers must ignore unknown fields.

pan_masked.description: The PAN with all but the last 4 characters masked.

pan_type.description: Holder type as reported (individual, company, ...), lower case.

registered_name.description: Name registered against the PAN, when the PAN is valid.

name_match.description: Whether the request's `name` matches the registered name (direct or good partial match). Null when no name was sent or no match result is available.

aadhaar_linked.description: Whether the PAN is linked to an Aadhaar (null for business PANs or when unknown).

vendor_ref.description: Opaque upstream reference for support correlation. Never parse it.
